newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes up in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes up in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed up by 0.56 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 522.73, up from 519.80 on Thursday.
Total volume was 1.4 million dinars, against 943,738 on Thursday.
Banque de Tunisie continued on its upward trend this week, rising 1.9 dinars to 84 dinars. Arab Tunisian Bank rose 1.04 dinars to 36.06 dinars. Retail stores Monoprix advanced 0.8 dinar to 38 dinars.
Coca and beer bottler SFBT was up 0.88 dinar to 96 dinars. Airline Tunis Air edged higher 0.4 dinar to 24 dinars.
